sentences.text: The aforementioned case has been registered on the basis of an FIR, lodged by Smti Barkha Chhetri on 16.10.2022.

The gist of the allegation against the accused is that being the husband of deceased Soniya Chhetri Katowal, he and his family members subjected her to both physical and mental cruelty, as a result of which, on 13.10.2022, she has committed suicide in the official quarter of the accused at Aizawl, by hanging.

Ms. N. Upadhyay, learned counsel for the accused submits that the accused was arrested on 18.10.2022, and since then he has been languishing in jail hazoot for 91 days and till date, no charge sheet has been submitted and as such, the accused is entitled to default bail, under Section 167(2)
CrPC.
On the other hand, Mr. BB Gogoi, learned Addl. P.P., Assam appearing for the State respondent has confirmed that no charge sheet has been submitted against the accused by the I.O., till date.
In view of above, this Court is of the view that the accused is entitled to default bail under Section 167(2) CrPC.

Accordingly, it is provided that on furnishing a bond of Rs.50,000/ (Rupees fifty thousands) only,
with one surety of like amount, to the satisfaction of learned SDJM (M), Margherita, the accused person, named above shall be enlarged on bail, in connection with the Lekhapani P.S. Case Page No.# 3/3 No.76/2022.
In terms of above this B.A. stands disposed of.
